visualReview.raw: I personally inspected all source and battle raw sheets. The coiled tail, torso, head, and four feet remain connected through idle, walk, gallop, jump, attack, hit reaction, death, entrance, cast, guard, rest, and victory. Death and entrance curl the neck and body down over the coil coherently; no detached limb or stretched face is visible.
visualReview.runtime: I personally inspected all low and medium runtime sheets for all 16 transitions on both source and battle models. The transition poses preserve the same connected silhouette. The head/neck orientation shifts with the body, and the feet remain attached; no extra collapse or separation is visible.
visualReview.idle: All 24 idle frames were inspected in the companion preview sheet. The upright neck, face, coil, and feet remain stable without visible discontinuity.
visualReview.techniques: I personally inspected all 36 front/side technique sheets, covering all nine techniques at 12 phases each. The small head, forefoot, and body pose changes remain connected; no visible face shear, limb separation, or deformation was found.
visualReview.atlas: I inspected the exact delivery atlas after confirming its manifest entry pins the reviewed battle GLB. All 16 cells show the same identity and connected body; the death cells are intentionally curled rather than separated.
visualReview.verdict: No confirmed distortion in the full required visual scope.

limitations: The earlier atlas file happened to have the same SHA-256 as the regenerated delivery atlas.
